Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Plants of the World Online: Ficus lyrata
RHS: how to grow ornamental figs

tr.description: Keman yapraklı kauçuk (Ficus lyrata) bakımı: parlak dolaylı ışık, sabit koşullar, dikkatli sulama ve evcil hayvan kaynaklarının neden ayrıştığı.
tr.imageAlt: Mavi gökyüzü önünde büyük, dalgalı, keman biçimli yapraklarıyla Ficus lyrata
tr.caption: Fotoğraf: Ficus lyrata, Diogo Luiz, iNaturalist üzerinden, CC BY 4.0. Kırpıldı ve yeniden boyutlandırıldı.

atAGlance.light: Parlak dolaylı ışık; sert öğleden sonra güneşinden koru
atAGlance.watering: Sulamalar arasında harç biraz kurusun; fazla suya hassastır
atAGlance.temperature: 13 °C'nin üstünde tut; cereyandan ve ani değişimlerden koru
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA veritabanında adıyla yok; bir ASPCA yazısı hafif toksik der

en.description: Fiddle-leaf fig care: bright indirect light, steady conditions, careful watering, how to handle leaf drop and why pet-safety sources disagree.
en.imageAlt: Fiddle-leaf fig with large, wavy, violin-shaped leaves against a blue sky
en.caption: Photo: Ficus lyrata by Diogo Luiz, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Cropped and resized.

atAGlance.light: Bright indirect light; shade it from strong afternoon sun
atAGlance.watering: Let the mix dry slightly between waterings; it is sensitive to overwatering
atAGlance.temperature: Keep above 13 °C (55 °F); avoid draughts and sudden swings
atAGlance.petSafety: Not in the ASPCA plant database by name; an ASPCA article calls it mildly toxic

es.description: Cuidados del ficus lira: luz indirecta brillante, condiciones estables, riego prudente y por qué las fuentes sobre mascotas no coinciden.
es.imageAlt: Ficus lira con grandes hojas onduladas en forma de violín contra un cielo azul
es.caption: Foto: Ficus lyrata de Diogo Luiz, vía iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Recortada y redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Luz indirecta brillante; protégelo del sol fuerte de la tarde
atAGlance.watering: Deja secar un poco el sustrato entre riegos; no tolera el exceso de agua
atAGlance.temperature: Por encima de 13 °C; evita corrientes y cambios bruscos
atAGlance.petSafety: No aparece por su nombre en la base de la ASPCA; un artículo de la ASPCA lo describe como levemente tóxico

de.description: Geigenfeige pflegen: helles indirektes Licht, stabile Bedingungen, vorsichtig gießen und warum Quellen zu Haustieren voneinander abweichen.
de.imageAlt: Geigenfeige mit großen, gewellten, geigenförmigen Blättern vor blauem Himmel
de.caption: Foto: Ficus lyrata von Diogo Luiz, über iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Zugeschnitten und verkleinert.

atAGlance.light: Hell und indirekt; vor greller Nachmittagssonne schützen
atAGlance.watering: Zwischen den Wassergaben leicht antrocknen lassen; reagiert empfindlich auf Staunässe
atAGlance.temperature: Über 13 °C; Zugluft und plötzliche Wechsel vermeiden
atAGlance.petSafety: Nicht namentlich in der ASPCA-Datenbank; ein ASPCA-Artikel nennt sie leicht giftig

pt.description: Cuidados com a figueira-lira: luz indireta clara, condições estáveis, rega cuidadosa e por que as fontes sobre pets não concordam.
pt.imageAlt: Figueira-lira com folhas grandes, onduladas e em forma de violino contra o céu azul
pt.caption: Foto: Ficus lyrata de Diogo Luiz, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Recortada e redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Luz indireta clara; proteja do sol forte da tarde
atAGlance.watering: Deixe o substrato secar um pouco entre regas; é sensível ao excesso de água
atAGlance.temperature: Acima de 13 °C; evite correntes de ar e mudanças bruscas
atAGlance.petSafety: Não aparece pelo nome no banco da ASPCA; um artigo da ASPCA a descreve como levemente tóxica

fr.description: Entretien du Ficus lyrata : lumière vive indirecte, conditions stables, arrosage prudent et pourquoi les sources sur les animaux divergent.
fr.imageAlt: Ficus lyrata aux grandes feuilles ondulées en forme de violon sur un ciel bleu
fr.caption: Photo : Ficus lyrata de Diogo Luiz, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Recadrée et redimensionnée.

atAGlance.light: Lumière vive indirecte ; à l’abri du fort soleil d’après-midi
atAGlance.watering: Laisser légèrement sécher entre deux arrosages ; craint l’excès d’eau
atAGlance.temperature: Au-dessus de 13 °C ; éviter courants d’air et écarts brusques
atAGlance.petSafety: Absent nommément de la base de l’ASPCA ; un article de l’ASPCA le dit légèrement toxique

ja.description: カシワバゴムノキの育て方。明るい間接光、安定した環境、慎重な水やり、落葉への対応と、ペット情報の見解の違いを説明します。
ja.imageAlt: 青空を背景に、縁が波打つ大きなバイオリン形の葉を広げたカシワバゴムノキ
ja.caption: 写真：Ficus lyrata、撮影：Diogo Luiz。iNaturalistより、CC BY 4.0。トリミング・サイズ変更済み。

atAGlance.light: 明るい間接光。強い午後の日差しは遮る
atAGlance.watering: 水やりの間に少し乾かす。水のやりすぎに敏感
atAGlance.humidity: 中程度から高めの湿度
atAGlance.temperature: 13℃（55℉）より高く保ち、すきま風や急な変化を避ける
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCAの植物データベースに学名での掲載なし。同機関の記事では軽い毒性に言及
atAGlance.careLevel: ある程度の注意が必要

ko.description: 떡갈고무나무 관리: 밝은 간접광, 일정한 환경, 신중한 물주기, 낙엽 대처와 반려동물 독성 자료가 서로 다른 이유를 알아보세요.
ko.imageAlt: 푸른 하늘을 배경으로 큰 바이올린 모양의 물결치는 잎을 보이는 떡갈고무나무
ko.caption: 사진: Ficus lyrata — 촬영: Diogo Luiz, iNaturalist 제공, CC BY 4.0. 잘라내고 크기를 조정했습니다.

atAGlance.light: 밝은 간접광. 강한 오후 햇빛은 가려 주세요
atAGlance.watering: 물주기 사이 흙을 약간 말리세요. 과습에 민감합니다
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA 식물 목록에 이 이름은 없으나 ASPCA의 글에서는 약한 독성이 있다고 설명합니다

it.imageAlt: Ficus lyrata con grandi foglie ondulate a forma di violino contro un cielo azzurro
it.caption: Foto: Ficus lyrata di Diogo Luiz, tramite iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Ritagliata e ridimensionata.

atAGlance.light: Luce intensa indiretta; proteggi dal sole pomeridiano forte
atAGlance.watering: Lascia asciugare leggermente; è sensibile all’eccesso d’acqua
atAGlance.petSafety: Assente per nome dal database ASPCA; un suo articolo lo definisce lievemente tossico

it.description: Cura del ficus lyrata: luce indiretta, condizioni stabili e acqua controllata. Caduta delle foglie e fonti discordanti sulla tossicità per animali.

zh-Hant.imageAlt: 琴葉榕寬大的小提琴形葉片，葉脈清晰可見
zh-Hant.caption: 照片： Ficus lyrata，攝影：Diogo Luiz，來源：iNaturalist， CC BY 4.0. 已裁切並調整尺寸。

atAGlance.light: 明亮間接光；避免強烈午後日照
atAGlance.watering: 介質稍乾再澆；對過度澆水敏感
atAGlance.temperature: 保持 13 °C（55 °F）以上，避免冷風與溫差
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA 植物資料庫未以此學名列出；一篇 ASPCA 文章稱其具輕微毒性

zh-Hant.description: 琴葉榕照護指南：穩定光線與溫度、澆水檢查、落葉排查及繁殖，並如實說明寵物毒性資料來源之間的差異。
